notes: Lantern's card is smooth in co-op now: its numbers come from a small native tracker built into the game mod (game mod 8.0) that reads the game the way Dauntless Forever's Boss Health Bar does, with no object searches, about 12 times a second. If it cannot run, the old tracking takes over by itself. Names: behemoths the game only names in its gear texts are named now (Sahvyt, Frostwülf, Urska, Phaelanx, Alyra), from 'forged from ... trophies'. Pick the Lantern card in Settings > Behemoth overlay > Style, then close the game fully so the new mod loads.
